enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Yawn. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth and washing up to start the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Scrub arms. Scrub legs. Scrub torso. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for tea, preparing and eating a relaxed weekend breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, butter. Take out frying pan. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Scramble eggs. Toast bread. Pour tea into cup. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting on the sofa watching TV and scrolling through the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer with the desk lamp on to review notes and plan upcoming community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open notes. Read notes. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Write plan. Save document. Open calendar. Schedule event. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room and tidying up clutter as weekend chores
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put away vacuum. Pick up clutter. Sort items. Put items away. Wipe surfaces. Turn on light. Turn off light. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple lunch on the induction cooker and eating at the table
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the bed and reading quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Adjust pillow. Continue reading. Close book. Put book aside. Close eyes. Rest. Open eyes. Pick up book. Read. Close book. Put book aside. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Out doing grocery shopping for the week and meeting friends for coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Leave house. Lock door. Walk to grocery store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Select items. Place in basket. Go to checkout. Pay. Bag items. Leave store. Walk to café. Meet friends. Greet. Order coffee. Sit. Drink coffee. Chat. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up and changing into comfortable clothes after being out
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face. Take off shirt. Take off pants. Put on t-shirt. Put on sweatpants. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing with music in the late afternoon
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up phone. Open music app. Play music. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the oven and induction cooker, then eating the evening meal
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Preheat oven. Turn on induction cooker. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Season meat. Place meat in oven. Stir vegetables in pan. Check oven. Take out meat. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Turn off oven. Turn off induction cooker. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing games on the game console and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up controller. Turn on game console. Start game. Play. Pause. Resume. Watch TV. Put down controller. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up controller. Play. Pause. Put down controller. Turn off game console. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing the phone with the desk lamp on before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put book aside. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Scroll. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the fan running
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Yawn. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
